$comment: The orchestration in force: its roles, their traits, who may create and mail whom. Code reads traits, never role names; another way of working is another copy of this file.
$comment_roomProject: Where the seats at home in the room sit: a folder in the room home, a project in the app.
$comment_roles: label, profile, icon, count, job: how the setup screen names and describes the role. home "room": above every project, reads all mail, keeps the registry. models: one, or named tiers. progress: a later STATUS starts no turn. briefs: writes briefs and verdicts for the seats under it. briefed: works from a brief. writes: changes the tree. reviews: reads and reports; the reviewers an Owner launches in one turn are one round. rotate: the line under its report past rotateAtTokens. tableNote: the line under its table in prompts. decides: the scopes whose decisions its seat records from a person's words.

hq.label: HQ
hq.job: Runs the room itself: watches every district, tunes the policy from what it measures, traces what goes wrong. It runs on one model.

supervisor.label: Supervisor
supervisor.job: Your counterpart in a project: it hands your requests to Leads, watches how the room works and proposes the smallest correction. It runs on one model.

lead.label: Lead
lead.job: Owns one request's outcome: plans it, briefs Peers, accepts or rejects their results. It runs on one model.
lead.rotate: This Lead {{held}}. Rotate it with seatwork_rotate at its next quiet point.

peer.label: Peer
peer.job: One role, several models, and a spec for the kind of work (search, scout, review, arch). The Lead picks the model and spec per task.
peer.rotate: This Peer {{held}}. Its repair goes on in the fresh seat seatwork_rotate starts; a new task goes to a new Peer.

$comment_reviewers: A seat of another role reviews too when its spec is one of `specs` or its title matches `titles`. stall: the params entry for how long a review round waits for its last reviewer.
$comment_notes: The room's own lines. {{rejected}}: rejections since the task's last ACCEPT; {{candidate}}: this candidate's number; {{role}}: the sender's role.

notes.secondCandidate: Second candidate of this task, after one rejection. If it fails too, the repair goes to a new Peer (its brief: the defects as failing tests, this candidate's sha, what was tried), and a defect of a kind the first review missed puts the design in question: `lenses` on it, or DECISION_NEEDED, before a writer continues.
notes.lastCandidate: Candidate {{candidate}} of this task: {{rejected}} rejections since its last ACCEPT. One more rejection is your Owner's call: DECISION_NEEDED with what each round found and what one more costs.
notes.upClosed: nothing travels up from a {{role}}: the Owner reads your final message and .seatwork/status.md (WAITING ON YOU rows); write there
notes.pastLastRound: Rejection {{rejected}} of this task since its last ACCEPT: a round past the second is your Owner's call. Unless your Owner gave you this round, report DECISION_NEEDED with what each round found and what one more costs; the task holds meanwhile.

$comment_routes: Who may mail whom, "<sender>><recipient>": a check against mistakes, no security boundary. Off from a seat to its parent: nothing travels up that way, the parent looks.
$comment_retired: Roles the room had and no longer has: their seats' providers are taken out of Paseo when the room is set up again.
$comment_spawn: Who may create whom: role, or role:spec for that spec only. A seat created outside it is archived and its parent told. A role that creates seats owns them.
